title: Cloud setup script installs claude-settings before start
why: shiv, Oct 30 15:05 and 15:09 CDT (item 77 A): a builder spawned with no model must run Sonnet; the builder-model setting is written too late in a cloud session.
note: Lane setup-script-install writes a setup script that fetches claude-settings and runs install.sh before Claude Code starts, then returns the paste block and a fresh-session test. Pasting it into the environment settings is shiv's act; it comes to him as a page task. Home: decision agent-model-cap. Done check: a fresh cloud session spawns a builder with no model and it runs Sonnet. Merged: #879 in batch 37 #904, main 502dbd5e (coordinator, Oct 31 17:09 CDT). The paste item closes. Left: the done check, a fresh cloud session whose builder runs Sonnet. Done check fails (coordinator, Nov 1 01:19 CST): in environment env_01RGfPzEB3iusXZwCZw5q5or, ~/.claude/settings.json sets CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL=sonnet but the session's process environment has it unset, so a builder with no model ran Opus in lanes cloud-merge-moves-pin and verdict-heartbeat-stderr-merge. Cause (coordinator probe, Nov 1 01:22 CST): the cloud CLI drops CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL and CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_SUBAGENT_MODEL when they come from settings.json ("Ignoring X from userSettings — provider routing is managed by the host"), so no setup script can fix it.
